native_review.summary: The user successfully requested a change of their default account address and all possible order addresses to 101 Highway, New York, 10001, then, after the agent confirmed the changes, requested the default address be reverted to the original. The agent correctly authenticated the user via name and zip code, identified which orders could be modified (only the pending order #W9911714), obtained explicit confirmation before each database update, and completed all requested changes. The user's claims and behavior were consistent with the scenario instructions, and no user errors were found. The only issues were minor agent policy violations: the agent repeatedly combined user-facing messages with tool calls and made multiple tool calls in a single turn, contrary to the policy's 'one tool call at a time' and 'no response while making a tool call' rules. These violations did not affect the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a message to the user and made a tool call (get_user_details) in the same turn. The policy states that the agent should at most make one tool call at a time and should not respond to the user while making a tool call.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have either sent the message or made the tool call, not both in the same turn.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a message to the user and made three get_order_details tool calls simultaneously in the same turn. The policy explicitly states the agent should make at most one tool call at a time and should not respond to the user when making a tool call.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the order detail lookups one at a time and avoided sending a user-facing message in the same turn as a tool call.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a message to the user and made two tool calls (modify_user_address and modify_pending_order_address) in the same turn. The policy requires at most one tool call at a time and prohibits responding to the user while making a tool call.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made each database-updating tool call separately, without including a user-facing message in the same turn.
